title: Filtering with WHERE Clause
description: Filter table rows using WHERE and comparison operators (=, !=, <, >, <=, >=).

blocks.content:
The `WHERE` clause filters rows before returning results:

```sql
SELECT * FROM products WHERE price > 50;
```

Comparison operators include: `=`, `!=` or `<>`, `<`, `>`, `<=`, `>=`.

blocks.question: Which comparison operator checks if two values are NOT equal in SQL?
blocks.explanation: Both != and <> are valid operators in standard SQL for inequality.

blocks.prompt: Retrieve `title` and `rating` for all movies with a `rating` greater than or equal to 8.5.
blocks.starterCode: -- Select title and rating where rating >= 8.5
blocks.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE movies (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT, rating REAL);
blocks.answer_sql: SELECT title, rating FROM movies WHERE rating >= 8.5;
